skill_short_description: Render charts and graphs as self-contained HTML files from four pinned CDN engines (Chart.js, Plotly.js, ECharts, Cytoscape.js) plus twelve template-native SVG engines (Concordance, HeatTree, PhyloTree, GenomeTracks, ClusterHeat, OncoPrint, SeqLogo, UpSet, Circos, GeoMap, Msaview, GeneArrows), chosen by chart type. Use when the user asks for a chart, plot, dashboard, heatmap, network/graph diagram, or any data visualization as a portable HTML file. No build step, no server, no pixi/conda/npm.
skill_description: Render charts and graphs as self-contained HTML files from four pinned CDN engines (Chart.js, Plotly.js, ECharts, Cytoscape.js) plus twelve template-native SVG engines (Concordance, HeatTree, PhyloTree, GenomeTracks, ClusterHeat, OncoPrint, SeqLogo, UpSet, Circos, GeoMap, Msaview, GeneArrows), chosen by chart type. One request → one portable HTML file. The agent classifies the request against SKILL.md §1, emits the engine's JSON spec per engines/<name>.md, and renders via the render_chart companion extension (v0.16.0) — which validates the spec, fills the template's /*__SPEC__*/ slot, runs the §6 checks, and delivers the absolute path; manual template-fill + self-check is the documented fallback when the extension is not loaded. Use when the user asks for a chart, plot, dashboard, heatmap, network/graph diagram, or any data visualization as a portable HTML file. No build step, no server, no inline third-party library code. Does NOT do text-to-flowchart/sequence diagrams (use Mermaid/lumen-generate_visual). Requires recomputation or a package-native analysis object (.h5ad, Seurat .rds, .cool, FCS, PDB/mmCIF)? Use the owning analysis pipeline skill (or general package knowledge) — chartz renders figures from data you already have: every plotted value must be nameable as a column in your input (the named-column check).
skill_triggers: bar chart / line chart / pie chart
multiple sequence alignment viewer / MSA plot
docs_corpus_rationale: Wraps no upstream CLI tools; engine spec contracts in engines/*.md + references/ + render-verified examples/ serve as the grounding corpus (stronger than --help captures).
pixi_rationale: Local runtime is python3 (stdlib only); browser engines are version-pinned via the SKILL.md §7 CDN table + template <script> tags, which pixi/conda cannot pin.

tool_inventory.name: python3
tool_inventory.role: stdlib only — spec JSON validation and the update check

battle_test_note: Hand-authored workflow-skill: no preflight/skill-built/battle-test-report evidence chain. De-facto battle-test = 53 example HTMLs verified non-blank with zero console errors in headless Chrome (examples/screenshots/).
